newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Creditor Korea First to seek Sammi buyer.
newsitem.headline: Creditor Korea First to seek Sammi buyer.

text.p: Main creditor Korea First Bank said on Wednesday it would seek a buyer for troubled Sammi Steel Co.
"We will hold intensive discussions with the court and try to normalise the company through a third party takeover," a bank statement said.
Sammi Steel, the nation's largest specialty steel maker, and four of its affiliates including Sammi Corp sought protection from creditors late on Tuesday.
Korea First Bank was also the main creditor to failed Hanbo Steel Co which filed for receivership under debts of $5.8 billion in the country's biggest corporate collapse.
Korea First Bank shares fell 140 won to 2,980 by midday on Wednesday.
